items: Transformer isolation and proper earthing is required.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, 
 breathing mask, and harness when 
 cleaning suspension insulators.

There is a danger of falling into the oil containment pit
 when working near large power transformers.

There is danger of falling off the top of the transformer when cleaning 
 insulators, wear your safety belt.

It is recommended to use only
 fiberglass (PVC) ladders when
 working in the switchyard.
Safety helmet, safety belt, and tool set

PVC
 ladders, breathing mask, rags

Check
 for signs of oil leaks.

Check
 oil levels in tank, conservator and oil filled bushings if possible.

Check
 oil temperature and winding temperature indicators, record maximum
 temperature indication from drag hand before resetting drag hand.

Make
 a visual inspection of all cooling fans.

Remove
 any debris from fan screens.

Switch
 on cooling fans manually and listen for abnormal noise.

Inspect
 the transformer control cabinet, check the condition of door seal blows out
 the inside of the control cabinet with compressed air using moderate
 pressure.

Perform
 the same inspection as in step 7 on the control cabinet of the tap changer.

Check
 the condition of the silica gel breather, replace silica-gel if one or more
 sections are discolored (from white to pink).

Check
 for correct level of sealing oil in lower glass cup.

Check
 for correct level in all high voltage bushings.

Thoroughly
 clean all porcelain surfaces of all bushings.

Return
 transformer bank to normal service.

Introduction
This document lists the equipment Inspection
checklist I1, which must be performed from one month to 3 months as indicated
by M1:3 in the title block. The first revised date 13 May 2002
Safety Precaution
Transformer isolation and proper earthing is required.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, 
 breathing mask, and harness when 
 cleaning suspension insulators.
There is a danger of falling into the oil containment pit
 when working near large power transformers.
There is danger of falling off the top of the transformer when cleaning 
 insulators, wear your safety belt.
It is recommended to use only
 fiberglass (PVC) ladders when
 working in the switchyard.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety belt, and tool set
PVC
 ladders, breathing mask, rags
Work to be carried out

Check

Make

Remove

Switch

Inspect

 the inside of the control cabinet with compressed air using moderate
 pressure.
Perform
 the same inspection as in step 7 on the control cabinet of the tap changer.
Check
 the condition of the silica gel breather, replace silica-gel if one or more

Check
 for correct level of sealing oil in lower glass cup.
Check

Thoroughly
